title: Curtain Up for 2026 Dalian Summer Davos! World's attention once again turns to Dalian - Global Press Release Distribution by Times Newswire
text:
The 17th Annual Meeting of the New Champions of the World Economic Forum (2026 Dalian Summer Davos) has officially begun in Dalian. This is the ninth time Dalian has collaborated with the Summer Davos. Dalian News Media Co., Ltd. is providing media coverage for the event.
More than 1,700 leaders and innovators from business, government, and academia have gathered here representing over 90 countries and regions. Guided by the theme “Scaling Innovation,” they are focusing on the new industrial era driven by artificial intelligence and frontier technologies, contributing innovative wisdom to global economic development and exploring pathways for collaborative growth.
The “Mind-Reading” Magic Mirror
Upon entering the venue, visitors are immediately immersed in a strong tech-driven atmosphere. What new experiences will arise when robots are integrated into human life?
A striking interaction unfolds when participants pause before the Mirror of Ritual, a creation by artist and researcher Nina Rajcic. The mirror captures the real-time state of each participant, as well as subtle emotional signals that they themselves might not even notice. A proprietary algorithm interprets emotional patterns and condenses their state of mind into a piece of poetic text, which is then displayed on the mirror’s surface.
Letting Go of Thoughts to “Dance” with Robots
A futuristic robotic installation has caught everyone’s eye. Participants simply put on a head sensor, and their brainwaves are instantly transmitted into the exhibit, causing it to move in sync with their current neurological state.
This is Take a Breath, Co-idle with AI, created by artist and researcher Emanuel Gollob. It challenges conventional perceptions through cutting-edge technology, constructing a mental space centered around the concept of “relaxation and non-action.”
Jessica Wanger, Head of Technology and Immersive Programs at the World Economic Forum’s Editorial Department, said: “People want to use AI to improve efficiency and do more things, but what makes this artwork special is that it encourages people to slow down and experience a different kind of energy that AI can offer.”
Touching “Sustainability”
Sustainability is the foundational design philosophy for the 2026 Dalian Summer Davos venue. Guided by the principles of “green throughout, full participation, and region-wide low carbon,” the concept of hosting a green conference has been fully integrated into every single step.
The venue has achieved a 100% direct supply of green electricity from renewable energy sources. Over 85% of construction materials are recycled and reused, while the waste recycling rate exceeds 90%, truly realizing a “zero-waste conference.”
A circular sharing model is applied to all furniture used at the venue. The furniture will be centrally collected after the conference, ensuring each piece of furniture achieves a circular lifespan of up to 5 years whenever possible.
In terms of transportation, green vehicles account for over 80% of the event’s support fleet. This includes the introduction of 16 hydrogen-powered buses, as well as 6 autonomous shuttle buses making their debut at this year’s forum.
Cutting-Edge Economic Views Take the Stage Here
The New Champions Village, located on the venue’s third floor, serves as a hub for guests from all over the world to exchange information and brainstorm ideas. This year, for the first time, the forum has consolidated all guest activity areas onto the same floor, meeting the needs of guests for convenient and highly efficient communication amidst their busy schedules.
Within the New Champions Village, when the “Davos On Air” light turns on, an in-depth dialogue is broadcast to the world from here. This is a brand-new podcast program and dialogue format launched by Winter Davos that will debut in China this year. Unlike traditional short Q&As, deep exchanges with Chinese and foreign guests take the form of in-depth interviews inside this dedicated recording studio.
The three-day
international grand event raises its curtain,
setting the stage for open dialogue
to build a global consensus for innovation and cooperation.
Text by Mao Xuemei and Chen Zixuan
Photos by Zhang Chunlei
